The '''CQ-3.99''' was a [[multispectrum disguise suite]] utilized during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were frequently sold by the [[S7-U44]] [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] for 900 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
